care.summary: Magnificent calathea with enormous, round, silvery-green leaves with subtle dark green stripes; a showstopping tropical plant.
care.light: Bright indirect light; leaves scorch in direct sun
care.water: Keep soil evenly moist; use distilled or rainwater
care.soil: Well-draining, peat-based potting mix with perlite and orchid bark
care.humidity: High (60-80%); essential for preventing leaf damage
care.fertilizer: Balanced fertilizer monthly in spring and summer; reduce in winter
common_issues: Brown leaf edges from low humidity or tap water chemicals
Pest issues (spider mites, scale) in dry conditions
tips: Use only distilled, filtered, or rainwater
Maintain high humidity with humidifier or pebble tray
Rotate plant weekly for even growth
Repot every 1-2 years in fresh soil
Remove older outer leaves to encourage new growth
